title: Story premise EDU071: The Raindrop Has a Downhill Address
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: Which river gets this drop? Takeaway/theme: Watershed boundaries follow terrain that directs surface runoff toward different outlets.
description: A raindrop wants to reach the river in a miniature landscape, but a flat map hides the ridges separating drainage routes. Raising the relief model shows its downhill path and the boundary of its watershed.
